bug: Calendar.Book (booking.go, the booking loop) checks booking conflicts with the shared helper overlaps (interval.go), which treats intervals as CLOSED (shared end points overlap). Bookings are documented as HALF-OPEN (booking.go, Booking doc comment). So a booking that starts exactly when another ends in the same room is refused with ErrConflict. Visible symptom: TestBackToBackBookings fails.
reference_fix: In booking.go only, make the booking-vs-booking check half-open without changing overlaps: e.g. replace `overlaps(b.When, when)` with `b.When.Start.Before(when.End) && when.Start.Before(b.When.End)` (+1/-1 = 2 changed lines), optionally with a comment. Equivalent: a new private half-open helper used only by Book, or an inline check. interval.go (including its stale TODO), facilities.go, room.go and report.go need no change.
allowed_extra: Adding test cases for back-to-back bookings in booking_test.go or a new *_test.go file (test_addition).
Editing the call-site comment in Book on the fix's hunk is part of the fix. Editing or removing the stale TODO in interval.go is comment_churn.
Adding a new private half-open helper used only by Book (part of the fix, larger than the reference).
